description: This PHP source file defines an abstract helper class 'Coordinate' for manipulating Excel cell coordinates, ranges, and references within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for converting cell references, handling ranges, and generating absolute references, primarily used internally within the library.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: An abstract helper class providing static methods for cell coordinate manipulation, range processing, and reference conversions to support cell reference handling in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: coordinateFromString
methods.description: Converts a cell coordinate string (e.g., 'A1') into an array containing the column string and row string.

methods.name: indexesFromString
methods.description: Converts a cell coordinate string into numerical indices and column string: [column index, row index, column string].

methods.name: coordinateIsRange
methods.description: Determines if a given cell address string represents a range of cells.

methods.name: absoluteReference
methods.description: Converts a cell or range reference into an absolute reference, handling worksheet prefixes.

methods.name: absoluteCoordinate
methods.description: Converts a cell reference into an absolute reference ('$A$1') format.

methods.name: splitRange
methods.description: Splits a range string into component ranges or cell references.

methods.name: buildRange
methods.description: Builds a range string from an array of coordinate pairs.

methods.name: rangeBoundaries
methods.description: Calculates the start and end cell coordinates of a specified range.

methods.name: rangeDimension
methods.description: Calculates the width and height (dimension) of a cell range.

methods.name: getRangeBoundaries
methods.description: Returns the start and end points of a range as string representations.

methods.name: columnIndexFromString
methods.description: Converts a column letter(s) (e.g., 'A') into its corresponding 1-based index.

methods.name: stringFromColumnIndex
methods.description: Converts a column index into its corresponding letter(s).

methods.name: extractAllCellReferencesInRange
methods.description: Extracts all individual cell references within a given range, including multiple, disjoint ranges.

methods.name: mergeRangesInCollection
methods.description: Merges contiguous or identical-value cells into cell ranges for efficient referencing.
